title: Madhya-khanda, part 11 (portion 34)
html:
The section "Mahaprabhu Distributes Prema in His Bhavas" (end): the Lord tells the devotees of the greatness of the sankirtana-yajna; the play in Chandrashekhara's house — the Lord in a gopi's dress, Srivasa in the bhava of Narada glorifies Gadadhara as Radha; the arrival of Haridasa and Advaita; the Lord in the bhava of Lakshmi and of the primal Shakti, Haridasa on Her lap; the bhava of Ishvara; Lochana Dasa's reflection on the hidden avatara

তার-পর-দিনে প্রভু বসি' দিব্যাসনে ।
কহিতে লাগিলা কিছু সব ভক্তগণে ॥ ৭২ ॥

tāra-para-dine prabhu basi' dibyāsane |
kahite lāgilā kichu saba bhaktagaṇe || 72 ||

tara-para-dine — on the next day; prabhu vasi divyasane — the Lord, seated on a divine seat; kahite lagila — began to say; kichhu saba bhakta-gane — something to all the devotees

72The next day the Lord, seated on a divine seat,
began to speak to all the devotees:

মোর এই সংকীর্তন-যজ্ঞের মহিমা ।
সব শাস্ত্রে কহে ইহার মহিমা গরিমা ॥ ৭৩ ॥

mora ei saṃkīrtana-yajñera mahimā |
saba śāstre kahe ihāra mahimā garimā || 73 ||

mora ei sankirtana-yajnera mahima — the greatness of this sankirtana-yajna of Mine; saba shastre kahe — all scriptures speak; ihara mahima garima — of its greatness and glory

73"Such is the greatness of this sankirtana-yajna of Mine:1
all the scriptures speak of its greatness and glory.

সর্বধর্মসার এই সংকীর্তন-ধর্ম ।
বিশেষ জানিবে কলিযুগে এই কর্ম ॥ ৭৪ ॥

sarbadharmasāra ei saṃkīrtana-dharma |
biśeṣa jānibe kaliyuge ei karma || 74 ||

sarva-dharma-sara — the essence of all dharmas; ei sankirtana-dharma — is this dharma of sankirtana; vishesha janibe — know especially; kali-yuge ei karma — in the Kali age this is the work

74This dharma of sankirtana is the essence of all dharmas;
know that in the Kali age this above all is the work to do.

পঞ্চম সে বেদ হৈতে প্রকাশ ইহার ।
শিব তেঞি পঞ্চমুখে গায় অনিবার ॥ ৭৫ ॥

pañcama se beda haite prakāśa ihāra |
śiba teñi pañcamukhe gāẏa anibāra || 75 ||

panchama se veda haite — from that fifth Veda; prakasha ihara — is its manifestation; shiva teni — therefore Shiva; pancha-mukhe gaya anibara — sings with five mouths ceaselessly

75It is revealed from the fifth Veda2 —
therefore Shiva sings [it] ceaselessly with his five mouths.

নারদ বীণায় গাই' বুলয়ে নাচিয়া ।
শুক-সনকাদি ভক্ত বুলয়ে গাইয়া ॥ ৭৬ ॥

nārada bīṇāẏa gāi' bulaẏe nāciẏā |
śuka-sanakādi bhakta bulaẏe gāiẏā || 76 ||

narada vinaya gai — Narada, singing to the vina; bulaye nachiya — wanders dancing; shuka-sanakadi bhakta — the devotees Shuka, Sanaka and others; bulaye gaiya — wander singing

76Narada wanders dancing, singing to his vina;
the devotees — Shuka, Sanaka and others — wander singing.

বৃন্দাবনে রাধাকৃষ্ণ এই বেদ লঞা ।
গোপী-সঙ্গে নাচি' বুলে প্রেমাবিষ্ট হঞা ॥ ৭৭ ॥

bṛndābane rādhākṛṣṇa ei beda lañā |
gopī-saṅge nāci' bule premābiṣṭa hañā || 77 ||

vrindavane radha-krishna — in Vrindavana Radha and Krishna; ei veda laña — taking this Veda; gopi-sange nachi bule — dance about with the gopis; premavishta haña — absorbed in prema

77In Vrindavana Radha and Krishna, taking up this Veda,
dance with the gopis, absorbed in prema.

নিত্য বৃন্দাবনে স্থিতি পঞ্চম জানিবে ।
তেঞি শিব গান করে মহাপ্রেমভাবে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

nitya bṛndābane sthiti pañcama jānibe |
teñi śiba gāna kare mahāpremabhābe || 78 ||

nitya vrindavane sthiti — eternal abiding in Vrindavana; panchama janibe — of the fifth [Veda], know; teni shiva gana kare — therefore Shiva sings; maha-prema-bhave — in great prema

78Know that the fifth [Veda] abides eternally in Vrindavana —
therefore Shiva sings in great prema.

তথাপি গাইয়া শিব ওর না পাইল ।
হেন বেদ কলিযুগে প্রকাশ হইল ॥ ৭৯ ॥

tathāpi gāiẏā śiba ora nā pāila |
hena beda kaliyuge prakāśa haila || 79 ||

tathapi gaiya shiva — yet, though singing, Shiva; ora na paila — did not find the end; hena veda — such a Veda; kali-yuge prakasha haila — appeared in the Kali age

79And yet, for all his singing, Shiva did not reach its end —
such a Veda has appeared in the Kali age.

গানে যেই করে সেই প্রবোধ হইয়া ।
গানরূপে বেদের উচ্চারে মহাদয়া ॥ ৮০ ॥

gāne yei kare sei prabodha haiẏā |
gānarūpe bedera uccāre mahādaẏā || 80 ||

gane yei kare — whoever performs [it] in song; sei prabodha haiya — he becomes awakened; gana-rupe — in the form of song; vedera uchchare — in the utterance of the Veda; maha-daya — is great mercy

80Whoever performs it in song is awakened:
the utterance of the Veda in the form of song is a great mercy.

সব-লোক-কর্ণ-গর্ত-কুণ্ড-পরিসর ।
জিহ্বা-স্রুব, ধ্বনি-রস-ঘৃত মনোহর ॥ ৮১ ॥

saba-loka-karṇa-garta-kuṇḍa-parisara |
jihbā-sruba, dhbani-rasa-ghṛta manohara || 81 ||

saba-loka-karna-garta — the ear-hollows of all people; kunda-parisara — the expanse of the sacrificial pit; jihva-sruva — the tongue is the ladle; dhvani-rasa-ghrita — the rasa of sound is the ghee; manohara — charming

81The hollows of everyone's ears are the expanse of the sacrificial pit,
the tongue is the ladle, the sweet rasa of the sound is the ghee.3

অন্তরে প্রবিষ্ট হঞা ভাব-অগ্নি জ্বালে ।
অগ্নি-শিখা—পুলকাশ্রু, কম্প কলেবরে ॥ ৮২ ॥

antare prabiṣṭa hañā bhāba-agni jbāle |
agni-śikhā—pulakāśru, kampa kalebare || 82 ||

antare pravishta haña — entering within; bhava-agni jvale — it kindles the fire of bhava; agni-shikha — the flames; pulakashru — thrill and tears; kampa kalebare — trembling of the body

82Entering within, it kindles the fire of bhava;
its flames are thrill and tears, the trembling of the body.

সর্বপাপে মুক্ত হৈয়া সব জন নাচে ।
সালোক্যাদি মুক্তি তার ফিরে পাছে পাছে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

sarbapāpe mukta haiẏā saba jana nāce |
sālokyādi mukti tāra phire pāche pāche || 83 ||

sarva-pape mukta haiya — freed from all sins; saba jana nache — all people dance; salokyadi mukti — the liberations, salokya and the rest; tara phire pachhe pachhe — wander after them

83Freed from all sins, all the people dance;
the liberations — salokya and the rest — follow them about,

কদাচ না দেখে সেই নয়ানের কোণে ।
নাচিয়া বুলয়ে কৃষ্ণ-রস-আস্বাদনে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

kadāca nā dekhe sei naẏānera koṇe |
nāciẏā bulaẏe kṛṣṇa-rasa-āsbādane || 84 ||

kadacha na dekhe — never look; sei nayanera kone — at those from the corner of the eye; nachiya bulaye — they wander dancing; krishna-rasa-asvadane — tasting Krishna's rasa

84but they never glance at them even from the corner of their eyes:
they wander dancing, tasting the rasa of Krishna.4

সে যজ্ঞ বেড়িয়া রহে বৈষ্ণব আচার্য ।
জানিবে কীর্তন-যজ্ঞ সর্বযজ্ঞ-আর্য ॥ ৮৫ ॥

se yajña beṛiẏā rahe baiṣṇaba ācārya |
jānibe kīrtana-yajña sarbayajña-ārya || 85 ||

se yajna bediya rahe — surround that yajna; vaishnava acharya — the Vaishnava acharyas; janibe — know; kirtana-yajna — the yajna of kirtana; sarva-yajna-arya — is the noblest of all yajnas

85The Vaishnava acharyas stand around this yajna;
know that the yajna of kirtana is the noblest of all yajnas.

ইহাতে জন্মিল এই প্রেম মহাধন ।
ইহার গৃহস্থ—নিত্যানন্দ-আবরণ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

ihāte janmila ei prema mahādhana |
ihāra gṛhastha—nityānanda-ābaraṇa || 86 ||

ihate janmila — from it was born; ei prema maha-dhana — this great treasure, prema; ihara grihastha — its master (yajamana); nityananda-avarana — Nityananda with His circle

86From it this great treasure, prema, was born;
the master of this [yajna] is Nityananda with His circle,

গদাধর-পণ্ডিত এই প্রেমের গৃহিণী ।
এই তত্ত্ব জানিবে সকল ভক্তমণি ॥ ৮৭ ॥

gadādhara-paṇḍita ei premera gṛhiṇī |
ei tattba jānibe sakala bhaktamaṇi || 87 ||

gadadhara-pandita — Gadadhara Pandita; ei premera grihini — is the mistress of this prema; ei tattva janibe — know this truth; sakala bhakta-mani — all jewels among devotees

87and the mistress of this prema is Gadadhara Pandita;5
know this truth, all you jewels among devotees.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি আমারে আনিঞা ।
সংকীর্তন-যজ্ঞ স্থাপে সুদৃঢ় হইয়া ॥ ৮৮ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi āmāre āniñā |
saṃkīrtana-yajña sthāpe sudṛṛha haiẏā || 88 ||

advaita-acharya-gosañi — Advaita Acharya Gosani; amare aniña — having brought Me; sankirtana-yajna sthape — establishes the sankirtana-yajna; sudridha haiya — firmly

88Advaita Acharya Gosani, having brought Me down,
firmly establishes the sankirtana-yajna.6

শ্রীনিবাস-নরহরি-আদি ভক্তগণ ।
তো-সভারে লঞা মোর যজ্ঞের স্থাপন ॥ ৮৯ ॥

śrīnibāsa-narahari-ādi bhaktagaṇa |
to-sabhāre lañā mora yajñera sthāpana || 89 ||

shrinivasa-narahari-adi bhakta-gana — the devotees Srinivasa, Narahari and others; to-sabhare laña — with all of you; mora yajnera sthapana — is the establishment of My yajna

89Srinivasa, Narahari and the other devotees —
with all of you I establish My yajna.

এই যজ্ঞ কলিকালে দেহ ঘরে ঘরে ।
তরুক সকল লোক পতিত পামরে ॥ ৯০ ॥

ei yajña kalikāle deha ghare ghare |
taruka sakala loka patita pāmare || 90 ||

ei yajna — this yajna; kali-kale — in the Kali age; deha ghare ghare — give from house to house; taruka sakala loka — let all people be delivered; patita pamare — the fallen and the sinful

90Carry this yajna in the Kali age from house to house —
let all the people, the fallen and the sinful, be delivered."

এ বোল শুনিঞা ভক্ত কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ।
প্রভুর চরণে পড়ে ঢলিয়া ঢলিয়া ॥ ৯১ ॥

e bola śuniñā bhakta kāndiẏā kāndiẏā |
prabhura caraṇe paṛe ḍhaliẏā ḍhaliẏā || 91 ||

e bola shuniña — hearing these words; bhakta kandiya kandiya — the devotees, weeping and weeping; prabhura charane pade — fall at the Lord's feet; dhaliya dhaliya — swaying

91Hearing this, the devotees, weeping and weeping,
fall at the Lord's feet, swaying.

সভারে করিলা কোলে গৌর ভগবান্ ।
শুনি আনন্দিত কথা এ লোচন গান ॥ ৯২ ॥

sabhāre karilā kole gaura bhagabān |
śuni ānandita kathā e locana gāna || 92 ||

sabhare karila kole — embraced all; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; shuni anandita katha — hearing the joyful story; e lochana gana — this Lochana sings

92Gaura Bhagavan embraced them all;
hearing this joyful story, this Lochana sings.

Raga varadi; the tune "dhulakhela"

আর অপরূপ কথা, শুন গোরা-গুণ-গাথা,
লোক-বেদ-অগোচর বাণী ।
আবেশের বশে করে, ভক্তিযোগ-পরচারে,
করুণাবিগ্রহ গুণমণি ॥ ৯৩ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā, śuna gorā-guṇa-gāthā,
loka-beda-agocara bāṇī |
ābeśera baśe kare, bhaktiyoga-paracāre,
karuṇābigraha guṇamaṇi || 93 ||

ara aparupa katha — another wondrous story; shuna gora-guna-gatha — hear the song of Gora's qualities; loka-veda-agochara vani — words beyond the world and the Vedas; aveshera bashe kare — acts in the sway of His bhava; bhakti-yoga-parachare — to proclaim bhakti-yoga; karuna-vigraha guna-mani — mercy embodied, the jewel of qualities

93Another wondrous story — hear the song of Gora's qualities,
words unknown to the world and to the Vedas.
In the sway of His bhava, to proclaim bhakti-yoga,
He acts — mercy embodied, the jewel of all qualities.

শুন কথা মন দিয়া, আন-কথা তেয়াগিয়া,
আর সব কহিবার বেলা ।
নিজজন সঙ্গে করি', শ্রীল বিশ্বম্ভর হরি,
শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখর-বাড়ী গেলা ॥ ৯৪ ॥

śuna kathā mana diẏā, āna-kathā teẏāgiẏā,
āra saba kahibāra belā |
nijajana saṅge kari', śrīla biśbambhara hari,
śrīcandraśekhara-bāṛī gelā || 94 ||

shuna katha mana diya — hear the story attentively; ana-katha teyagiya — leaving other talk; ara saba kahibara bela — it is time to tell the rest; nija-jana sange kari — together with His own; shrila vishvambhara hari — Srila Vishvambhara Hari; shri-chandrashekhara-badi gela — went to Sri Chandrashekhara's house

94Hear the story attentively, leaving other talk:
it is time to tell the rest as well.
Together with His own, Srila Vishvambhara Hari
went to the house of Sri Chandrashekhara.7

কথা-পরসঙ্গে কথা, গোপিকার গুণগাথা,
কহিতে সে গদগদ ভাষ ।
অরুণ বয়ান ভেল, দুনয়ানে ঝরে নীর,
রসাবেশে রসের প্রকাশ ॥ ৯৫ ॥

kathā-parasaṅge kathā, gopikāra guṇagāthā,
kahite se gadagada bhāṣa |
aruṇa baẏāna bhela, dunaẏāne jhare nīra,
rasābeśe rasera prakāśa || 95 ||

katha-parasange katha — in the course of talk the talk [turned]; gopikara guna-gatha — to the gopis' qualities; kahite se gadgada bhasha — speaking, His voice faltered; aruna bayana bhela — His face grew red; dunayane jhare nira — tears stream from His eyes; rasaveshe rasera prakasha — absorbed in rasa, He reveals rasa

95In the course of talk the conversation turned to the qualities of the gopis —
and, speaking of them, His voice faltered;
His face grew red, tears streamed from His eyes —
immersed in rasa, He revealed rasa.

কমলা যাহার পদ, সেবা করে উনমত,
হেন প্রভু গোপিকার তরে ।
পরসঙ্গে হয় ভোরা, হেন ভক্তি কৈল তারা,
কথামাত্র সে আবেশ ধরে ॥ ৯৬ ॥

kamalā yāhāra pada, sebā kare unamata,
hena prabhu gopikāra tare |
parasaṅge haẏa bhorā, hena bhakti kaila tārā,
kathāmātra se ābeśa dhare || 96 ||

kamala yahara pada — whose feet Kamala; seva kare unamata — serves in rapture; hena prabhu gopikara tare — such a Lord, for the gopis' sake; parasange haya bhora — is overwhelmed at the mention; hena bhakti kaila tara — such devotion they showed; katha-matra se avesha dhare — at mere words takes on that bhava

96The Lord whose feet Kamala serves in rapture —
such a Lord, for the gopis' sake,
is overwhelmed at the mere mention [of them]: such was the devotion they showed!
At mere words He takes on their bhava.

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর হরি, গোপিকার বেশ ধরি',
শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখরাচার্য-ঘরে ।
নাচয়ে আনন্দে ভোলা, শ্রীবাস হেনই বেলা,
নারদ-আবেশ ভেল তারে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

tabe biśbambhara hari, gopikāra beśa dhari',
śrīcandraśekharācārya-ghare |
nācaẏe ānande bholā, śrībāsa henai belā,
nārada-ābeśa bhela tāre || 97 ||

tabe vishvambhara hari — then Vishvambhara Hari; gopikara vesha dhari — putting on a gopi's dress; shri-chandrashekharacharya-ghare — in Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya's house; nachaye anande bhola — dances, lost in bliss; shrivasa henai bela — Srivasa at that very hour; narada-avesha bhela tare — the bhava of Narada came upon him

97Then Vishvambhara Hari, putting on a gopi's dress,
in the house of Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya
dances, lost in bliss; and at that very hour
the bhava of Narada came upon Srivasa.8

প্রভুরে প্রণাম করে, বিনয়-বচনে বোলে,
দাস করি' জানিহ আমারে ।
এমন কহিয়া বাণী, তবে সেই মহামুনি,
গদাধর-পণ্ডিতেরে বোলে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

prabhure praṇāma kare, binaẏa-bacane bole,
dāsa kari' jāniha āmāre |
emana kahiẏā bāṇī, tabe sei mahāmuni,
gadādhara-paṇḍitere bole || 98 ||

prabhure pranama kare — bows to the Lord; vinaya-vachane bole — says humbly; dasa kari janiha amare — know me as a servant; emana kahiya vani — having spoken such words; tabe sei maha-muni — then that great sage; gadadhara-panditere bole — speaks to Gadadhara Pandita

98He bows to the Lord and humbly says:
"Know me as Your servant."
Having spoken these words, that great sage
then addresses Gadadhara Pandita:

শুনহ গোপিকা তুমি, যে কিছু কহিয়ে আমি,
তোর পূর্বকথা কিছু জান ।
অপূর্ব কহিয়ে আমি, জগতে দুর্লভ তুমি,
তোর কথা শুন সাবধান ॥ ৯৯ ॥

śunaha gopikā tumi, ye kichu kahiẏe āmi,
tora pūrbakathā kichu jāna |
apūrba kahiẏe āmi, jagate durlabha tumi,
tora kathā śuna sābadhāna || 99 ||

shunaha gopika tumi — listen, gopi; ye kichhu kahiye ami — to what I say; tora purva-katha kichhu jana — do you know anything of your past; apurva kahiye ami — I tell a wonder; jagate durlabha tumi — you are rare in the world; tora katha shuna savadhana — hear attentively about yourself

99"Listen, gopi, to what I shall say:
do you know anything of your past?
I shall tell a wonder: you are rare in the world —
hear attentively about yourself.

শুন তো-সভার কথা, আমি কহি গুণগাথা,
গোকুলে জন্মিলা জনে জনে ।
ছাড়ি' নিজ পতিব্রত, সেবা কৈল অবিরত,
অভিমত পাঞা বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ১০০ ॥

śuna to-sabhāra kathā, āmi kahi guṇagāthā,
gokule janmilā jane jane |
chāṛi' nija patibrata, sebā kaila abirata,
abhimata pāñā bṛndābane || 100 ||

shuna to-sabhara katha — hear about all of you; ami kahi guna-gatha — I tell your qualities; gokule janmila jane jane — you were born one by one in Gokula; chhadi nija pativrata — leaving your fidelity to husbands; seva kaila avirata — served unceasingly; abhimata pana vrindavane — attaining your desire in Vrindavana

100Hear about all of you — I shall sing your qualities:
you were born, one and all, in Gokula;
leaving your fidelity to your husbands, you served [Krishna] unceasingly
and attained your heart's desire in Vrindavana.9

প্রধান প্রকৃতি তুমি, কৃষ্ণশক্তি রাধা তুমি,
কি জানি তা কহিবারে আমি ॥ ১০১ ॥

pradhāna prakṛti tumi, kṛṣṇaśakti rādhā tumi,
ki jāni tā kahibāre āmi || 101 ||

pradhana prakriti tumi — you are the first prakriti (shakti); krishna-shakti radha tumi — you are Radha, Krishna's shakti; ki jani — what do I know; ta kahibare ami — for me to tell of it

101You are the first of prakritis, you are Radha, Krishna's shakti:10
what do I know, that I could tell of it?

রমণীর শিরোমণি, কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-সোহাগিনী,
তোর তত্ত্ব কি বলিতে জানি ॥ ১০২ ॥

ramaṇīra śiromaṇi, kṛṣṇaprema-sohāginī,
tora tattba ki balite jāni || 102 ||

ramanira shiromani — crown of women; krishna-prema-sohagini — favoured in Krishna's love; tora tattva — your truth; ki balite jani — how could I know to tell

102Crown of all women, the favoured one in Krishna's love —
how could I tell your truth?

এঁছন করিলে ভক্তি, কেহো নহে সমযুক্তি,
পরম নিগূঢ় তিন-লোকে ।
ব্রহ্মা, মহেশ্বর দেবা, লখিমী অনন্ত কিবা,
তাকে অধিক পরসাদ তোকে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

eṁchana karile bhakti, keho nahe samayukti,
parama nigūṛha tina-loke |
brahmā, maheśbara debā, lakhimī ananta kibā,
tāke adhika parasāda toke || 103 ||

enchhana karile bhakti — you showed such devotion; keho nahe sama-yukti — none is equal; parama nigudha tina-loke — the supreme secret in the three worlds; brahma maheshvara deva — Brahma, the god Maheshvara; lakhimi ananta kiba — Lakshmi, and even Ananta; take adhika parasada toke — more grace than to them — to you

103You showed such devotion that none can equal [you];
it is the supreme secret of the three worlds.
Brahma, the god Maheshvara, Lakshmi and even Ananta
have less grace than you.

প্রহ্লাদ-নারদাদিক, সনাতন আদি শুক,
না জানয়ে তোর ভক্তি-লেশ ।
ত্রৈলোক্য-লখিমী-পতি, চাহে তোর পিরীতি,
স্ব-অঙ্গে ধরয়ে বর-বেশ ॥ ১০৪ ॥

prahlāda-nāradādika, sanātana ādi śuka,
nā jānaẏe tora bhakti-leśa |
trailokya-lakhimī-pati, cāhe tora pirīti,
sba-aṅge dharaẏe bara-beśa || 104 ||

prahlada-naradadika — Prahlada, Narada and others; sanatana adi shuka — Sanatana, Shuka and the rest; na janaye tora bhakti-lesha — do not know a drop of your devotion; trailokya-lakhimi-pati — the Husband of the Lakshmi of the three worlds; chahe tora piriti — longs for your love; sva-ange dharaye bara-vesha — puts a lovely dress on His own body

104Prahlada, Narada and others, Sanatana, Shuka and the rest
know not a drop of your devotion.
The Husband of the Lakshmi of the three worlds longs for your love —
and puts this lovely dress on His own body.11

লখিমী যাহার দাসী, তোর প্রেম-প্রত্যাশী,
হৃদয়ে ধরয়ে অনুরাগ ।
সকল-ভুবন-পতি, ভুলাইলা সে পিরীতি,
ধনি ধনি তোহারি সোহাগ ॥ ১০৫ ॥

lakhimī yāhāra dāsī, tora prema-pratyāśī,
hṛdaẏe dharaẏe anurāga |
sakala-bhubana-pati, bhulāilā se pirīti,
dhani dhani tohāri sohāga || 105 ||

lakhimi yahara dasi — He whose maidservant is Lakshmi; tora prema-pratyashi — hoping for your prema; hridaye dharaye anuraga — holds longing in His heart; sakala-bhuvana-pati — the Lord of all worlds; bhulaila se piriti — you enchanted with that love; dhani dhani tohari sohaga — blessed, blessed is your tenderness

105He whose maidservant is Lakshmi, hoping for your prema,
holds in His heart a longing [for you];
the Lord of all the worlds you have enchanted with that love —
blessed, blessed is your tenderness!

তোরা সে জানিলি তত্ত্ব, প্রভু-মর্ম-মহত্ত্ব,
পিরীতি বান্ধিলি ভালমতে ।
উদ্ধব-অক্রূর-আদি, সভে তোর পদসেবী,
অনুগত না ছাড়িহ চিতে ॥ ১০৬ ॥

torā se jānili tattba, prabhu-marma-mahattba,
pirīti bāndhili bhālamate |
uddhaba-akrūra-ādi, sabhe tora padasebī,
anugata nā chāṛiha cite || 106 ||

tora se janili tattva — you have known the truth; prabhu-marma-mahattva — the greatness of the Lord's inmost heart; piriti bandhili bhalamate — bound [Him] fast with love; uddhava-akrura-adi — Uddhava, Akrura and others; sabhe tora pada-sevi — all serve your feet; anugata na chhadiha chite — do not forsake your followers in your heart

106You have known the truth — the greatness of the Lord's inmost heart —
and have bound [Him] fast with love.
Uddhava, Akrura and the rest — all serve your feet:
do not forsake in your heart those who follow you."

এতেক কহিল বাণী, শ্রীনিবাস দ্বিজমণি,
শুনি আনন্দিত সর্বজন ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব মিলি', সভে করে কোলাকুলি,
দেখি' বিশ্বম্ভর-চরণ ॥ ১০৭ ॥

eteka kahila bāṇī, śrīnibāsa dbijamaṇi,
śuni ānandita sarbajana |
sakala baiṣṇaba mili', sabhe kare kolākuli,
dekhi' biśbambhara-caraṇa || 107 ||

eteka kahila vani — spoke such words; shrinivasa dvija-mani — Srinivasa, jewel of brahmanas; shuni anandita sarvajana — hearing, all rejoiced; sakala vaishnava mili — all the Vaishnavas together; sabhe kare kolakuli — embrace one another; dekhi vishvambhara-charana — gazing at Vishvambhara's feet

107Such words spoke Srinivasa, the jewel of brahmanas;
hearing them, all rejoiced.
All the Vaishnavas together embrace one another,
gazing at Vishvambhara's feet.

নাচয়ে আনন্দে ভোরা, প্রেমে গরগর তারা,
হেনকালে আইলা হরিদাস ।
দণ্ড এক করি' করে, সম্মুখে দাণ্ডাইয়া বোলে,
গুণ গায় পরম উল্লাস ॥ ১০৮ ॥

nācaẏe ānande bhorā, preme garagara tārā,
henakāle āilā haridāsa |
daṇḍa eka kari' kare, sammukhe dāṇḍāiẏā bole,
guṇa gāẏa parama ullāsa || 108 ||

nachaye anande bhora — they dance, lost in bliss; preme garagara tara — they overflow with prema; henakale aila haridasa — at that hour Haridasa came; danda eka kari kare — taking a staff in his hand; sammukhe dandaiya bole — standing in front, he says; guna gaya parama ullasa — sings the qualities in supreme delight

108They dance, lost in bliss, overflowing with prema —
and at that hour Haridasa came.
Staff in hand, he stood in front and proclaims,
singing [the Lord's] qualities in supreme delight:12

হরিগুণ-সংকীর্তন, কর ভাই অনুক্ষণ,
ইহা বলি' অট্ট অট্ট হাসে ।
হরিগুণ-গানে ভোরা, দুনয়ানে বহে ধারা,
আনন্দে ফিরয়ে চারিপাশে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

hariguṇa-saṃkīrtana, kara bhāi anukṣaṇa,
ihā bali' aṭṭa aṭṭa hāse |
hariguṇa-gāne bhorā, dunaẏāne bahe dhārā,
ānande phiraẏe cāripāśe || 109 ||

hari-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's qualities; kara bhai anukshana — perform, brothers, without cease; iha bali atta atta hase — so saying, laughs aloud; hari-guna-gane bhora — lost in singing Hari's qualities; dunayane bahe dhara — streams flow from his eyes; anande phiraye charipashe — in joy turns to every side

109"Brothers, perform the sankirtana of Hari's qualities without cease!" —
so saying, he laughs aloud.
Lost in singing Hari's qualities, he sheds streams from his eyes
and in joy turns round to every side.

শুনি হরিদাস-বাণী, সকল বৈষ্ণবমণি,
অমৃতে সিঞ্চিলা সব গা ।
হরষেতে নাচে গায়, মাঝে নাচে গোরারায়,
কান্দিয়া ধরয়ে রাঙ্গা পা ॥ ১১০ ॥

śuni haridāsa-bāṇī, sakala baiṣṇabamaṇi,
amṛte siñcilā saba gā |
haraṣete nāce gāẏa, mājhe nāce gorārāẏa,
kāndiẏā dharaẏe rāṅgā pā || 110 ||

shuni haridasa-vani — hearing Haridasa's words; sakala vaishnava-mani — all the jewel-like Vaishnavas; amrite sinchila saba ga — [as if] their whole bodies were sprinkled with nectar; harashete nache gaya — in joy they dance and sing; majhe nache goraraya — in the midst dances Gora-raya; kandiya dharaye ranga pa — weeping, they clasp His reddish feet

110Hearing Haridasa's words, all the jewel-like Vaishnavas —
as if their whole bodies were sprinkled with nectar:
in joy they dance and sing, in their midst dances Gora-raya,
and, weeping, they clasp His reddish feet.

তবে সর্বগুণধাম, অদ্বৈত-আচার্য নাম,
আইলা সব বৈষ্ণবের রাজা ।
রূপে আলোকিত মহী, সম্মুখে দাণ্ডায় চাহি',
প্রভু-অংশে জন্ম মহাতেজা ॥ ১১১ ॥

tabe sarbaguṇadhāma, adbaita-ācārya nāma,
āilā saba baiṣṇabera rājā |
rūpe ālokita mahī, sammukhe dāṇḍāẏa cāhi',
prabhu-aṃśe janma mahātejā || 111 ||

tabe sarva-guna-dhama — then the abode of all virtues; advaita-acharya nama — named Advaita Acharya; aila saba vaishnavera raja — came, the king of all Vaishnavas; rupe alokita mahi — the earth lit by His beauty; sammukhe danday chahi — stands in front gazing; prabhu-amshe janma maha-teja — born of the Lord's portion, of great might

111Then came the abode of all virtues, named Advaita Acharya,
the king of all the Vaishnavas;
His beauty lit up the earth; He stands in front and gazes —
born of the Lord's portion, of great might.13

হরি হরি বলি' ডাকে, চমক লাগিল লোকে,
আনন্দে নাচয়ে প্রেমভরে ।
পুলকিত সব গা, আপাদ-মস্তক যা,
প্রেমবারি দুনয়ানে ঝরে ॥ ১১২ ॥

hari hari bali' ḍāke, camaka lāgila loke,
ānande nācaẏe premabhare |
pulakita saba gā, āpāda-mastaka yā,
premabāri dunaẏāne jhare || 112 ||

hari hari bali dake — calls "Hari, Hari!"; chamaka lagila loke — the people start; anande nachaye premabhare — dances in joy, full of prema; pulakita saba ga — the whole body thrills; apada-mastaka ya — from feet to head; prema-bari dunayane jhare — tears of prema stream from His eyes

112"Hari, Hari!" He calls, and the people start;
in joy He dances, filled with prema;
His whole body thrills from feet to head,
tears of prema stream from His eyes.

বিশ্বম্ভর-শ্রীচরণে, নেহারই ঘনে ঘনে,
হুঙ্কারে মারে মালসাট ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব মিলি', প্রেমের পসরা ডালি,
পসারিল অপরূপ হাট ॥ ১১৩ ॥

biśbambhara-śrīcaraṇe, nehārai ghane ghane,
huṅkāre māre mālasāṭa |
sakala baiṣṇaba mili', premera pasarā ḍāli,
pasārila aparūpa hāṭa || 113 ||

vishvambhara-shri-charane — at Vishvambhara's holy feet; neharai ghane ghane — gazes again and again; hunkare mare malasata — roars and slaps His arms; sakala vaishnava mili — all the Vaishnavas together; premera pasara dali — baskets of the wares of prema; pasarila aparupa hata — spread out a wondrous market

113Again and again He gazes at Vishvambhara's holy feet,
roars and slaps His arms like a wrestler;
all the Vaishnavas together, opening baskets of the wares of prema,
spread out a wondrous market.

সকল বৈষ্ণবগণে, অতি আনন্দিত মনে,
প্রেমের সাগরে দিল ডুব ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব মিলি', আপনে শ্রীগৌরহরি,
প্রকাশয়ে সংসারের সুখ ॥ ১১৪ ॥

sakala baiṣṇabagaṇe, ati ānandita mane,
premera sāgare dila ḍuba |
sakala baiṣṇaba mili', āpane śrīgaurahari,
prakāśaẏe saṃsārera sukha || 114 ||

sakala vaishnava-gane — all the Vaishnavas; ati anandita mane — rejoicing at heart; premera sagare dila duba — plunged into the ocean of prema; sakala vaishnava mili — with all the Vaishnavas; apane shri-gaurahari — Sri Gaurahari Himself; prakashaye samsarera sukha — reveals happiness to the world

114All the Vaishnavas, rejoicing at heart,
plunged into the ocean of prema;
with all the Vaishnavas Sri Gaurahari Himself
reveals happiness to the world.

এখনে কহিব শুন, সাবধানে সর্বজন,
গোপিকা-আবেশ-বশ প্রভু ।
হৃদয়ে কাঁচলি পরে, শঙ্খ-কঙ্কণ করে,
দুটি আঁখি রসে ডুবুডুবু ॥ ১১৫ ॥

ekhane kahiba śuna, sābadhāne sarbajana,
gopikā-ābeśa-baśa prabhu |
hṛdaẏe kāṁcali pare, śaṅkha-kaṅkaṇa kare,
duṭi āṁkhi rase ḍubuḍubu || 115 ||

ekhane kahiba shuna — now I shall tell, listen; savadhane sarvajana — all, attentively; gopika-avesha-basha prabhu — the Lord in the sway of a gopi's bhava; hridaye kanchali pare — puts a bodice on His breast; shankha-kankana kare — conch bangles on His wrists; duti ankhi rase dubudubu — both eyes drowning in rasa

115And now I shall tell — listen, all, attentively:
the Lord, in the sway of a gopi's bhava,
puts a bodice on His breast, conch-shell bangles on His wrists;
both His eyes are drowning in rasa.

পট্টবসন পরে, নূপুর চরণে ধরে,
মুঠে পাই ক্ষীণ মাঝাখানি ।
রূপে ত্রিজগত মোহে, উপমা দিবার কাহে,
গোপীবেশে ঠাকুর আপনি ॥ ১১৬ ॥

paṭṭabasana pare, nūpura caraṇe dhare,
muṭhe pāi kṣīṇa mājhākhāni |
rūpe trijagata mohe, upamā dibāra kāhe,
gopībeśe ṭhākura āpani || 116 ||

patta-basana pare — wears silk; nupura charane dhare — anklets on the feet; muthe pai kshina majhakhani — a slender waist a fist could clasp; rupe trijagata mohe — the beauty charms the three worlds; upama dibara kahe — to what to compare; gopi-veshe thakura apani — the Thakura Himself in a gopi's dress

116He wears silk, anklets on His feet,
His waist so slender a fist could clasp it;
His beauty charms the three worlds — to what can it be compared? —
the Thakura Himself in a gopi's dress.14

অলৌকিক অঙ্গতেজে, বায়ু বহে মলয়জে,
তাহে নব মালতীর মালা ।
সুমেরু-শিখরে যেন, সুরধুনী-জল হেন,
গোরা-অঙ্গে বহে দুই ধারা ॥ ১১৭ ॥

alaukika aṅgateje, bāẏu bahe malaẏaje,
tāhe naba mālatīra mālā |
sumeru-śikhare yena, suradhunī-jala hena,
gorā-aṅge bahe dui dhārā || 117 ||

alaukika anga-teje — from the unearthly radiance of His body; vayu bahe malayaje — a Malaya breeze blows; tahe nava malatira mala — on Him a garland of fresh malati; sumeru-shikhare yena — as on the peak of Sumeru; suradhuni-jala hena — the waters of the heavenly river; gora-ange bahe dui dhara — two streams flow on Gora's body

117From the unearthly radiance of His body a Malaya breeze blows,
on Him is a garland of fresh malati;
like the waters of the heavenly river on the peak of Sumeru,
two streams [of tears] flow over Gora's body.

সকল বৈষ্ণব-মাঝে, নাচে মহানটরাজে,
রসের আবেশে ভাব ধরে ।
এমন করিতে পুন, লখিমী পড়িল মন,
সে আবেশে গেলা দেবঘরে ॥ ১১৮ ॥

sakala baiṣṇaba-mājhe, nāce mahānaṭarāje,
rasera ābeśe bhāba dhare |
emana karite puna, lakhimī paṛila mana,
se ābeśe gelā debaghare || 118 ||

sakala vaishnava-majhe — amid all the Vaishnavas; nache mahanataraje — dances the great king of dancers; rasera aveshe bhava dhare — takes on bhavas in the rapture of rasa; emana karite puna — and as He did so; lakhimi padila mana — He thought of Lakshmi; se aveshe gela deva-ghare — in that bhava went into the Deity's chamber

118Amid all the Vaishnavas dances the great king of dancers,
taking on bhavas in the rapture of rasa.
And as He danced thus, He thought of Lakshmi —
and in that bhava went into the Deity's chamber.

ঘরে সাম্ভাইয়া অতি, দিব্য চতুর্ভুজ-মূর্তি,
দেখি' দাণ্ডাইল তার কাছে ।
আধ-নয়ানে চায়, আধ-পদ চলি' যায়,
বসনে ঢাকিল আঁখি পাছে ॥ ১১৯ ॥

ghare sāmbhāiẏā ati, dibya caturbhuja-mūrti,
dekhi' dāṇḍāila tāra kāche |
ādha-naẏāne cāẏa, ādha-pada cali' yāẏa,
basane ḍhākila āṁkhi pāche || 119 ||

ghare sambhaiya — entering the chamber; ati divya chaturbhuja-murti — the most divine four-armed Deity; dekhi dandaila tara kachhe — seeing, He stood beside It; adha-nayane chaya — looks with half-closed eyes; adha-pada chali yaya — walks with half-steps; basane dhakila ankhi pachhe — covered His eyes with His cloth

119Entering the chamber and seeing the divine four-armed Deity,
He stood beside It;
He looks with half-closed eyes, walks with half-steps,
and has covered His eyes with the edge of His cloth.15

তবে সব নিজজনে, পড়ি' তার শ্রীচরণে,
বিনয়-বচনে করে স্তুতি ।
শ্রীস্তব পঢ়ে কেহো, আনন্দে বিভোর সেহো,
বর মাগে—দেহ প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ১২০ ॥

tabe saba nijajane, paṛi' tāra śrīcaraṇe,
binaẏa-bacane kare stuti |
śrīstaba paṛhe keho, ānande bibhora seho,
bara māge—deha premabhakti || 120 ||

tabe saba nija-jane — then all His own; padi tara shri-charane — falling at His holy feet; vinaya-vachane kare stuti — offer praise with humble words; shri-stava padhe keho — someone recites the Sri-stava; anande vibhora seho — he, lost in bliss; bara mage — asks a boon; deha prema-bhakti — give prema-bhakti

120Then all His own, falling at His holy feet,
offer praise with humble words;
someone recites the Sri-stava and, lost in bliss,
asks a boon: "Give prema-bhakti!"

সর্বজন স্তব করে, শুনি' সেই সেইকালে,
আদ্যাশক্তি পড়ি' গেল মনে ।
সেই ত আবেশ ধরে, সর্বজন চমৎকারে,
স্তব পঢ়ে কত সুরগণে ॥ ১২১ ॥

sarbajana staba kare, śuni' sei seikāle,
ādyāśakti paṛi' gela mane |
sei ta ābeśa dhare, sarbajana camatkāre,
staba paṛhe kata suragaṇe || 121 ||

sarvajana stava kare — all offer praise; shuni sei seikale — hearing it, at that very moment; adya-shakti padi gela mane — He thought of the primal Shakti; sei ta avesha dhare — takes on that very bhava; sarvajana chamatkare — all are amazed; stava padhe kata sura-gane — recite many hymns of the gods

121All offer praise; hearing it, at that very moment
He thought of the primal Shakti
and took on that very bhava; all are amazed
and recite many hymns composed by the gods.16

তবে স্তব কৈল সভে, সুরকৃত মহাস্তবে,
তুষ্ট হঞা বোলে আদ্যাশক্তি ।
দেবতা-আসনে বসি', কহে লহু লহু হাসি',
দেখিবারে আইলুঁ প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ১২২ ॥

tabe staba kaila sabhe, surakṛta mahāstabe,
tuṣṭa hañā bole ādyāśakti |
debatā-āsane basi', kahe lahu lahu hāsi',
dekhibāre āiluṁ premabhakti || 122 ||

tabe stava kaila sabhe — when all had offered praise; sura-krita maha-stave — with great hymns composed by the gods; tushta haña bole adya-shakti — pleased, the primal Shakti says; devata-asane vasi — seated on the Deity's seat; kahe lahu lahu hasi — says with a soft smile; dekhibare ailun prema-bhakti — I have come to see prema-bhakti

122When all had offered praise with the great hymns of the gods,
the primal Shakti, pleased, speaks;
seated on the Deity's seat, She says with a soft smile:
"I have come to see [your] prema-bhakti.

তো-সভার নৃত্যগীতে, আইলুঁ দেখিবার চিতে,
কহিলুঁ আপন অভিলাষ ।
এ বোল শুনিঞা পুন, কহে সেই সব জন,
নিজভক্তি কর পরকাশ ॥ ১২৩ ॥

to-sabhāra nṛtyagīte, āiluṁ dekhibāra cite,
kahiluṁ āpana abhilāṣa |
e bola śuniñā puna, kahe sei saba jana,
nijabhakti kara parakāśa || 123 ||

to-sabhara nritya-gite — your dancing and singing; ailun dekhibara chite — I came wishing to see; kahilun apana abhilasha — I have told My desire; e bola shuniña puna — hearing this, again; kahe sei saba jana — all those people say; nija-bhakti kara parakasha — reveal devotion to Yourself

123I have come wishing to see your dancing and singing —
I have told you My desire."
Hearing this, all those people say again:
"Reveal [in us] devotion to You."

এ বর মাগিল যবে, আদ্যাশক্তি বোলে তবে,
শুন শুন শুন সর্বজনে ।
আমি চণ্ডী পরচণ্ড, তোমারও হবে দণ্ড,
এই বর দিল সর্বজনে ॥ ১২৪ ॥

e bara māgila yabe, ādyāśakti bole tabe,
śuna śuna śuna sarbajane |
āmi caṇḍī paracaṇḍa, tomārao habe daṇḍa,
ei bara dila sarbajane || 124 ||

e bara magila yabe — when they asked this boon; adya-shakti bole tabe — then the primal Shakti says; shuna shuna shuna sarvajane — listen, listen, listen, all; ami chandi parachanda — I am Chandi, the fierce; tomaro habe danda — you too shall have the rod; ei bara dila sarvajane — this boon She gave to all

124When they asked this boon, the primal Shakti said:
"Listen, listen, listen, all!
I am Chandi, the fierce: you too shall have the rod!" —
such was the boon She gave to all.17

এ বোল শুনিঞা তবে, পরণাম করে সভে,
দণ্ডবত ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ।
তবে সেই ঈশ্বরী, হরিদাস-করে ধরি',
কোলে বসাইল সে হাসিয়া ॥ ১২৫ ॥

e bola śuniñā tabe, paraṇāma kare sabhe,
daṇḍabata bhūmite paṛiẏā |
tabe sei īśbarī, haridāsa-kare dhari',
kole basāila se hāsiẏā || 125 ||

e bola shuniña tabe — hearing this; paranama kare sabhe — all bow down; dandavata bhumite padiya — falling to the ground like a stick; tabe sei ishvari — then that Mistress; haridasa-kare dhari — taking Haridasa by the hand; kole vasaila se hasiya — smiling, seated him on Her lap

125Hearing this, all bow down,
falling to the ground like a stick.
Then that Mistress, taking Haridasa by the hand,
smiling, seated him on Her lap.

বসিয়া তাহার কোলে, হরিদাস ঘন দোলে,
পাঁচ-বরিষের যেন শিশু ।
আশ্চর্য দেখিয়া মনে, আনন্দিত সর্বজনে,
হরিষ পাইল পক্ষী পশু ॥ ১২৬ ॥

basiẏā tāhāra kole, haridāsa ghana dole,
pāṁca-bariṣera yena śiśu |
āścarya dekhiẏā mane, ānandita sarbajane,
hariṣa pāila pakṣī paśu || 126 ||

vasiya tahara kole — sitting on Her lap; haridasa ghana dole — Haridasa rocks to and fro; pancha-barishera yena shishu — like a child of five; ashcharya dekhiya mane — seeing the marvel; anandita sarvajane — all rejoiced at heart; harisha paila pakshi pashu — birds and beasts were glad

126Sitting on Her lap, Haridasa rocks to and fro
like a child of five.
Seeing this marvel, all rejoiced at heart;
even the birds and beasts were glad.

এইক্ষণে একজন, কহেন এই বচন,
মুরারিকে চাহ দয়া-দিঠি ।
এ তোমার নিজদাস, এ বোল শুনিঞা হাস,
অমিয়া-অধিক লহু মিঠি ॥ ১২৭ ॥

eikṣaṇe ekajana, kahena ei bacana,
murārike cāha daẏā-diṭhi |
e tomāra nijadāsa, e bola śuniñā hāsa,
amiẏā-adhika lahu miṭhi || 127 ||

eikshane ekajana — at that moment someone; kahena ei vachana — speaks these words; murarike chaha daya-dithi — look on Murari with a merciful glance; e tomara nija-dasa — he is Your own servant; e bola shuniña hasa — hearing this, a smile; amiya-adhika lahu mithi — soft, sweeter than nectar

127At that moment someone spoke these words:
"Cast a merciful glance on Murari:
he is Your own servant." Hearing this, [She] smiled
softly, sweeter than nectar.

নয়ান করুণাজলে, প্রেম ছলছল করে,
করুণ অরুণ মুখচন্দ্র ।
হেনকালে শচীদেবী, আপনে শ্রীপাদ সেবি',
প্রেমানন্দে ভেল পরতন্ত্র ॥ ১২৮ ॥

naẏāna karuṇājale, prema chalachala kare,
karuṇa aruṇa mukhacandra |
henakāle śacīdebī, āpane śrīpāda sebi',
premānande bhela paratantra || 128 ||

nayana karuna-jale — the eyes in tears of compassion; prema chhalachhala kare — brim with prema; karuna aruna mukha-chandra — the tender moon of the face grew red; henakale shachi-devi — at that hour Shachi-devi; apane shri-pada sevi — herself serving the holy feet; premanande bhela paratantra — was overcome by the bliss of prema

128Her eyes are full of tears of compassion, brimming with prema,
the tender moon of Her face grew red.
At that hour Shachi-devi, herself serving [His] holy feet,
was overcome by the bliss of prema.

তবে সেই কাত্যায়নী, সর্বজন কাছে আনি',
নিজ সুত করি' হেন মানে ।
মাতৃস্নেহ করে লোকে, সর্বজন দেখি' তাকে,
প্রেমজলে ভরে দুনয়ানে ॥ ১২৯ ॥

tabe sei kātyāẏanī, sarbajana kāche āni',
nija suta kari' hena māne |
mātṛsneha kare loke, sarbajana dekhi' tāke,
premajale bhare dunaẏāne || 129 ||

tabe sei katyayani — then that Katyayani; sarvajana kachhe ani — drawing all near; nija suta kari hena mane — regards them as Her sons; matri-sneha kare loke — shows the people a mother's tenderness; sarvajana dekhi take — all, looking at Her; prema-jale bhare dunayane — fill their eyes with tears of prema

129Then that Katyayani, drawing all near,
regards them as Her own sons;
She shows the people a mother's tenderness, and all, looking at Her,
fill their eyes with tears of prema.18

হেনকালে সেইক্ষণে, আসি' এক ব্রাহ্মণে,
প্রভু বলি' ডাকে উচ্চনাদে ।
আর্তজন-আর্তি দেখি', ছলছল করে আঁখি,
ভই গেল ঈশ্বর-উন্মাদে ॥ ১৩০ ॥

henakāle seikṣaṇe, āsi' eka brāhmaṇe,
prabhu bali' ḍāke uccanāde |
ārtajana-ārti dekhi', chalachala kare āṁkhi,
bhai gela īśbara-unmāde || 130 ||

henakale seikshane — at that hour, at that moment; asi eka brahmane — a brahmana came; prabhu bali dake uchchanade — called loudly "Prabhu!"; arta-jana-arti dekhi — seeing the suffering of the sufferer; chhalachhala kare ankhi — the eyes filled with tears; bhai gela ishvara-unmade — He entered the rapture of Ishvara

130At that hour, at that very moment, a brahmana came
and loudly called: "Prabhu!"
Seeing the suffering of the sufferer, His eyes filled with tears,
and He entered the rapture [of the bhava] of Ishvara.

আপনি ঈশ্বর হঞা, নিজপ্রেম প্রকাশিঞা,
নিজগুণে করে ঠাকুরাল ।
সর্বজন বেড়ি বেড়ি, দণ্ড-পরণাম করি',
দেখি' ঈশ্বর-আবেশ পুনর্বার ॥ ১৩১ ॥

āpani īśbara hañā, nijaprema prakāśiñā,
nijaguṇe kare ṭhākurāla |
sarbajana beṛi beṛi, daṇḍa-paraṇāma kari',
dekhi' īśbara-ābeśa punarbāra || 131 ||

apani ishvara haña — becoming Ishvara Himself; nija-prema prakashiña — revealing His prema; nija-gune kare thakurala — shows His lordship by His qualities; sarvajana bedi bedi — all, surrounding Him; danda-paranama kari — prostrating; dekhi ishvara-avesha punarbara — seeing again the bhava of Ishvara

131Becoming Ishvara Himself, revealing His prema,
He shows His lordship by His own qualities.
All, surrounding Him, prostrated themselves,
seeing again [in Him] the bhava of Ishvara.

এইমতে সব নিশে, গোঙাইয়া রসাবেশে,
প্রভাতে চলিলা নিজঘরে ।
যত জন সঙ্গে যায়, দেখে যেন গোরারায়,
কেবল প্রচণ্ড দণ্ড ধরে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

eimate saba niśe, goṅāiẏā rasābeśe,
prabhāte calilā nijaghare |
yata jana saṅge yāẏa, dekhe yena gorārāẏa,
kebala pracaṇḍa daṇḍa dhare || 132 ||

ei-mate saba nishe — thus the whole night; gonaiya rasaveshe — spending in the rapture of rasa; prabhate chalila nija-ghare — at dawn He went home; yata jana sange yaya — all who go with Him; dekhe yena goraraya — see as if Gora-raya; kevala prachanda danda dhare — holds a fierce rod

132Thus, spending the whole night in the rapture of rasa,
at dawn He went home.
All who went with Him saw Gora-raya
as if holding a fierce rod.19

হেনমতে গৌরহরি, করুণা প্রকাশ করি',
অখিল ভুবনে এককর্তা ।
করুণা-কারণ আসি', দীনভাব পরকাশি',
আপে করে পৃথিবীর চিন্তা ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

henamate gaurahari, karuṇā prakāśa kari',
akhila bhubane ekakartā |
karuṇā-kāraṇa āsi', dīnabhāba parakāśi',
āpe kare pṛthibīra cintā || 133 ||

henamate gaurahari — thus Gaurahari; karuna prakasha kari — revealing mercy; akhila bhuvane eka-karta — the one Maker in all the worlds; karuna-karana asi — coming for mercy's sake; dina-bhava parakashi — showing humility; ape kare prithivira chinta — Himself cares for the earth

133Thus Gaurahari, the one Maker of all the worlds,
revealed His mercy;
having come for mercy's sake and showing humility,
He Himself cares for the earth.

হেন অপরূপ কথা, শুনিঞা সংসার-ব্যথা,
না ঘুচয়ে যাহার অন্তরে ।
না ঘুচিব কোনকালে, যে ইথি সংশয় ধরে,
তারে ধিক নাহিক পামরে ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

hena aparūpa kathā, śuniñā saṃsāra-byathā,
nā ghucaẏe yāhāra antare |
nā ghuciba konakāle, ye ithi saṃśaẏa dhare,
tāre dhika nāhika pāmare || 134 ||

hena aparupa katha — such a wondrous story; shuniña — hearing; samsara-vyatha — the pain of samsara; na ghuchaye yahara antare — is not removed from whose heart; na ghuchiba konakale — will never be removed; ye ithi samshaya dhare — whoever doubts this; tare dhika — shame on him; nahika pamare — no [worse] wretch

134If anyone, hearing so wondrous a story, is not freed
in his heart from the pain of samsara —
he will never be freed from it; and whoever doubts this —
shame on him: there is no worse wretch.

যুক্তি অনুভব শাস্ত্র, তিনে কহে এইমাত্র,
সাক্ষাতে না দেখি পরচার ।
বিচার না করে ইহা, না ছিল সে হৈল সিয়া,
কেমনে তার হইব নিস্তার ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

yukti anubhaba śāstra, tine kahe eimātra,
sākṣāte nā dekhi paracāra |
bicāra nā kare ihā, nā chila se haila siẏā,
kemane tāra haiba nistāra || 135 ||

yukti anubhava shastra — reason, experience and scripture; tine kahe ei-matra — the three say just this; sakshate na dekhi parachara — one does not see it openly proclaimed; vichara na kare iha — who does not ponder this; na chhila se haila siya (?) — what was not has come to be; kemane tara haiba nistara — how will he be delivered

135Reason, experience and scripture — all three say just this,
though one does not see it openly proclaimed;
whoever does not ponder this — that what never was has come to be —
how will such a one be delivered?20

গোরা-অবতার হেন, করুণা প্রকাশ যেন,
নাহি হয় না হইব আর ।
যে বলু সে বলু লোকে, অনুভব কহি তাকে,
মনে মনে করুক বিচার ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

gorā-abatāra hena, karuṇā prakāśa yena,
nāhi haẏa nā haiba āra |
ye balu se balu loke, anubhaba kahi tāke,
mane mane karuka bicāra || 136 ||

gora-avatara hena — such an avatara as Gora; karuna prakasha yena — such a revelation of mercy; nahi haya na haiba ara — is not and will not be again; ye balu se balu loke — let people say what they will; anubhava kahi take — I tell them what I have realised; mane mane karuka vichara — let them reflect within

136Such an avatara as Gora, such a revelation of mercy,
has never been and never will be.
Let people say what they will — I tell them what I have realised:
let them reflect on it within themselves.

এইমাত্র মোর চিন্তা, অন্তরে অন্তর-ব্যথা,
হেন অবতার যায় পাছে ।
তা লাগি' কান্দয়ে হিয়া, কাহারে কহিব ইহা,
গুণ গায় এ লোচন দাসে ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

eimātra mora cintā, antare antara-byathā,
hena abatāra yāẏa pāche |
tā lāgi' kāndaẏe hiẏā, kāhāre kahiba ihā,
guṇa gāẏa e locana dāse || 137 ||

ei-matra mora chinta — this alone is my care; antare antara-vyatha — a pain deep in the heart; hena avatara yaya pachhe — lest such an avatara pass by; ta lagi kandaye hiya — for this the heart weeps; kahare kahiba iha — to whom shall I tell this; guna gaya e lochana dase — this Lochana Dasa sings the qualities

137One care I have, a pain deep in my heart:
lest such an avatara pass [people] by.
For this my heart weeps — to whom shall I tell it?
This Lochana Dasa sings [Gora's] qualities.

✦

Notes

  1. Cf. Bhagavata 11.5.32: in the age of Kali the intelligent worship the Lord by a yajna consisting chiefly of sankirtana. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary of these pastimes is at the head of the section (en/33).
  2. The "fifth Veda" usually means the itihasas and puranas (Bhagavata 1.4.20); Lochana Dasa gives this name to the sung word, the Veda "in the form of song" (v. 80) revealed in the Kali age. "With five mouths" is a play on words: Shiva has five faces.
  3. Kirtana is described as a yajna: the sacrificial pit (kunda), the ladle (sruva) with which ghee is poured into the fire, and the ghee itself.
  4. The pure devotees do not accept the five kinds of liberation (salokya, sarupya and so on) if they contain no service to the Lord (Bhagavata 3.29.13).
  5. The image is that of a Vedic yajna, which the master (yajamana) performs together with his wife. Nityananda is the giver of prema; Gadadhara Pandita is, in the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Sri Radha (en/25, note 7), whose prema this is.
  6. Advaita Acharya (Maha-Vishnu, en/27, note 8) brought the Lord down into this world by His calls.
  7. Chandrashekhara Acharya (Acharyaratna) is the husband of Shachi's sister, the Lord's aunt. The play in his house: Murari 2.15.7–19, 2.16; Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya 18 (where the Lord appears in the bhava of Rukmini and of the primal Shakti, Gadadhara as Her companion, Haridasa as a watchman with a staff, Srivasa as Narada). Bhaktisiddhanta's summary is at the head of the section (en/33).
  8. According to the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika, Srivasa is Narada. The gopi's dress and the bhavas of a gopi, of Lakshmi and of the primal Shakti which the Lord shows in this play are His own lila: the shakti is non-different from the Possessor of shakti, and He reveals the bhavas of His shaktis. This is no worldly dressing-up or play-acting.
  9. The gopis' love for Krishna is pure prema, above all worldly duties; their "husbands" are a mere appearance created by yogamaya (Bhagavata 10.33.37). There is nothing worldly here.
  10. Prakriti here means Krishna's shakti, His internal energy, not material nature (the pradhana of Sankhya). Gadadhara Pandita is Sri Radha (en/25, note 7). In A this stanza is printed under two numbers, 101 and 102 (one per half-stanza); in the 1983 edition it is a single stanza (9). We follow A's numbering; next, A misprints "100" for 103.
  11. That is, the Lord, longing for Radha's love, has Himself put on a gopi's dress — a hint at the secret of Gaura's appearance, in which He took Radha's bhava and complexion (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 1.5–6).
  12. Cf. Murari 2.16.1. In the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 18) Haridasa in this play is a watchman-herald with a staff.
  13. Advaita Acharya is Maha-Vishnu (en/27, note 8); the word "portion" does not diminish Him. Cf. Murari 2.16.3–4.
  14. Cf. Murari 2.16.7–8.
  15. Cf. Murari 2.16.11–13. The half-closed eyes, half-steps and veil are the feminine modesty of Lakshmi, whose bhava the Lord reveals.
  16. The primal Shakti (Adya-shakti) — in Lochana Dasa she is also Chandi and Katyayani (vv. 124, 129). In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding the Lord's primal shakti is His internal energy (yogamaya); Durga, who rules the material world, is her shadow and the Lord's servant (Brahma-samhita 5.44). The Lord reveals the bhava of His own shakti, non-different from Him (cf. Murari 2.16.15 and note 8 above); this is neither possession nor the worship of another deity.
  17. The rod (danda) is a sign of power and fierce might; the 1983 edition has "you will all become fierce". In Murari (2.16.17–18) the Goddess jokes that people will take Her devotees for worshippers of Chandi. Cf. also v. 132.
  18. According to Murari (2.16.20–21) and the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 18), the Lord in this bhava gave the devotees milk from His breast, like a mother.
  19. Cf. Murari 2.16.23: the Lord, as if holding a staff in His hand, seemed to the people like the flame of the blazing sun.
  20. Gaura is the hidden (channa) avatara: the scriptures speak of Him covertly (Bhagavata 7.9.38; 11.5.32). The line "না ছিল সে হৈল সিয়া" is unclear in all witnesses; we translate by sense.
